items.title: Expand Trial Footprints Without Expanding Cryopreservation Risk
items.summary: For many cell therapy programs, the move from fresh to frozen starting material is treated as the moment when variability starts to come under control. And in many ways, that’s true. Fresh leukapheresis-derived starting material is inherently difficult to build around. It is biologically active, time-sensitive, and highly dependent on how quickly and consistently it can move from collection into the next step of the process. Even under strong operational oversight, additional variables around timing, handling, transport duration, pre-processing wait time, and local execution can all influence the condition of the material before manufacturing ever begins.
